ngos.title: Pocket true-CW 2 m handheld (fixture)
ngos.statement: The owner needs a pocket-sized 2 m handheld that sends and receives true CW with a straight key or iambic paddles.
ngos.rationale: Distilled from SI-001, SI-005 and SI-018 (fixture).

ngos.title: Useful simplex range
ngos.statement: Two radios complete CW contacts over open ground at several kilometres at 5 W.
ngos.rationale: SI-003 chose 5 W for useful simplex range (fixture).

ngos.title: 5 km open-ground contact
ngos.statement: Two units complete a two-way exchange at 5 km over open ground at the 5 W step.
ngos.rationale: Measurable target for NGO-002; Baselined so that the T-20 Objective coverage rule is exercised (cited by MOE-001).

moes.title: Transmit power delivered
moes.statement: The radio delivers its rated power into the antenna so that the range goal is met.
moes.success_criterion: 5 W plus or minus 1 dB into a 50 ohm load across the band, measured at SAR.
moes.rationale: Judges NGO-002 and NGO-003 in scenario OPS-001 (fixture).

constraints.title: Part 97 applies
constraints.statement: The radio is operated under 47 CFR Part 97 by licensed operators.
constraints.rationale: Imposed by the FCC; no relief (fixture).
